findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to `startOfDay(day)` on line 8 and then increments the date by one on line 9, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day. This breaks the function's contract and likely affects any code relying on the previous behavior.

summary.problem: The refactor of `endOfDay` changes its contract, returning the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day.
summary.done_well: The new code uses `startOfDay` to avoid duplication and clearly expresses the intent to move to the next day.
